status: P0 DONE 2026-09-23 (eafa7f7): TSed : TUtil, tests 004/005/006 (282 checks green on bash 5.2.37 and 5.3.9, threaded and --mode single on 5.2.37), README first cut, TUTIL_OUT_SUFFIXES registry in tutil. P1 (closeout) planned. Plan: critic-hardened 2026-09-22 (18 findings, all folded into PLAN.md §8); six owner decisions Q1–Q6.

decisions.Q1: sandbox = 1 by default (e, s///e, r, R, w, W refused by sed); sandbox = 0 opts out
decisions.Q2: both var expr and proc addExpr/clearExprs over ${inst}_exprs; plus var scriptFile (-f)
decisions.Q3: 0->0; 1,2,4 -> 1 + debug; 127 base; any other (q/Q status) -> 1 silent, raw in lastRc
decisions.Q4: inPlace + backupSuffix; run only; the five sinks overridden and rc 2 with inPlace = 1
decisions.Q5: inPlace = 1 and nullData = 1 derive -b in buildArgv (text mode rewrites CRLF to LF on disk, even the identity, and strips a CR inside a NUL record); the binary property is never written
decisions.Q6: deny-list in buildArgv for extras that duplicate a typed property or break the stream: -i/--in-place, -z/--null-data, -e/--expression, -f/--file, -n/--quiet/--silent, -s/--separate, -E/-r/--regexp-extended, -b/--binary, --sandbox, and bundled short words containing i z e f n s E r b; --posix, -u, -l N, --follow-symlinks, --debug pass

Then tutil: TUTIL_OUT_SUFFIXES=(_args _argv _paths) at load, tutil._badOut refuses ${inst}${suffix} for every entry with the two guards (its own name refused; empty/unset/non-array refuses every name). Then tsed.sh per PLAN §1.2: Create (parent.constructor sed, 11 vars, sandbox=1), Destroy, paths/addExpr/clearExprs, buildArgv (pinned order, every option before the first -e, derived -b for binary/inPlace/nullData, -i with the suffix attached, the §2.2 rc 2 list, the Q6 deny-list in getopt terms, nullData -> nul with the P3-F1 guard), mapRc (Q3 wording), the five sinks overridden (inPlace or --debug -> rc 2; else the rc-preserving spelling, each as a proc), TSed.edit (empty expr + addExpr, sandbox forced, >= 1 path). Green: 267/267 on both bashes (threaded; --mode single on 5.2.37); tutil/tgrep/thead/ttail/tfind green on 5.2.37 (tutil on 5.3.9 too). Measured at P0: `*` in the -i suffix is the operand as given, not the base name (PLAN §1.1 correction, pinned in 005); first on a partial failure gives lastRc 2 deterministically (40/40 on each bash). README first cut; tutil README §5, PLAN §7 and docs/TUtil.md §4 tsed rows amended. REVIEW (supervisor, 2026-09-23): suite reproduced 282/282 on bash 5.2.37 and 5.3.9; probes: --debug and its abbreviations (--deb, --de, --d) refused in all sinks; review round 1 made `sandbox` FAIL CLOSED (--sandbox dropped only for the exact string 0 — measured before the fix: '', yes, 2 all opened it) and put `--` on the deny-list (measured before: `addArg --` turned the expressions into operands); deviation 1 (the deny-list follows sed's own abbreviation and attached-argument parsing: --in=, --expr=, --null, --sand, -i.bak, -es/a/b/) APPROVED as Q6's intent; the `*`-in-suffix fact corrected in PLAN §1.1/§2.2 (the operand as given, directory included). Master sweep: the first run failed ONE case on both bashes, tinifile 011_T6 position ratio (sec20 5x sec1 under that run's load) — not reproducible standalone, threaded, under the master env, or after thead (1.1-1.2x each time); both reruns 27/27 0 [FAIL] (ratio 1.1x/1.2x). Pre-existing load-sensitive tinifile assertion, recorded as an open item next to the dateutils now/nowUTC flake. Committed as kcl eafa7f7.

Opus critic, 9 probe scripts and a prototype on the real tutil, both bashes byte-identical (5.2.37 resolves Git for Windows' sed, 5.3.9 msys64's; both 4.9). No blockers. MAJORS: (1) in-place in text mode rewrites CRLF to LF on disk, even the identity -> owner Q5: inPlace and nullData derive -b; (2) addArg -i / -ni / -z / --expression / -f bypass the typed properties (a sink edits or truncates the file with rc 0, loses records, reorders the script) -> owner Q6: deny-list; (3) ${inst}_exprs is fillable as an out-name, so records become the next run's script -> TUTIL_OUT_SUFFIXES registry with the two guards, tsed appends _exprs; (4) TSed.edit '' could not be the identity -> edit uses addExpr; (5) the missing-file pin was wrong for each (a proc, rc 1, RESULT untouched) and first (rc 0 + record + lastRc 2, the consumer-stop contract) -> restated. MINOR/NIT: rc 4 stops processing at the operand (not partial like rc 2), a missing -f script is rc 4; the backupSuffix rule targeted harmless characters — `*` alone (no backup, silently) is now rc 2, `*` and `/` documented; a script's q1/q2/q4 looks like a sed error (debug wording says so) and -i + q/Q/-n truncates silently (README trap); sandbox also refuses s///w incl. /dev/stdout and does not guard -i; --debug prints to stdout (sinks refused); a callback's bare assignment writes the instance's properties (bare sandbox=0 disarms the default — README trap); tutil/docs/TUtil.md §4 stale tsed row; #n and a\ across chunks; -i on -; two sed binaries; S5/S9 fixture details; -i implies -s. Verified: the proc each override keeps rc, frame, __TPIPE_QUIET, D6, this, no per-record cost; the refusal leaves _lastRc -1 and the file intact; the sandbox is compile-time and total.

Owner: start tsed. GNU sed 4.9 measured under both bashes (byte-identical): each -e is compiled when read, so every option must precede the first -e (`-e 's/(/X/' -E` silently runs as BRE); `sed FILE` takes FILE as the script; rc 1 bad script, 2 missing input (partial output kept), 4 I/O, q/Q N any status; text mode strips CR, -b keeps it; -z NUL records; one stream across files unless -s; -i writes nothing to stdout, suffix attached; e/s///e/r/w/W execute or touch files, --sandbox refuses them. Owner decided four questions before the plan: sandbox on by default; both expr and addExpr; rc 1/2/4 with debug, q/Q status silent; inPlace + backupSuffix with run only. PLAN.md + this ledger written. No code.
